task: Alert-conditioned event retrieval under fixed investigation costs
primary_claim: Event relevance retrieval; activity disentanglement requires separate independent membership references
development_case: TC E3 CADETS graph_12, previously exposed

phase_0.history: empty at arm start, continuous across selected windows
phase_0.purpose: Check loading and describe scoring differences on identical features
phase_0.not_identified: The causal effect of feature-space mismatch

phase_1.scope: Consistent local adaptation, not exact author reproduction
phase_1.word2vec_fit_scope: Only entities and metadata visible in training graphs; metadata must not use future updates
phase_1.word2vec_oov: Average known-token vectors; if none, zero semantic vector with original node-type features retained; never normalize zero
phase_1.checkpoint_selection: Minimum event-weighted validation negative log likelihood; earliest epoch breaks ties
phase_1.training_and_validation_history: Reset at epoch start; process training in time order, then later validation; same policy at every checkpoint
phase_1.development_test_history: Restore selected checkpoint history and apply the predeclared validation-to-test policy; log unobserved gaps, do not manufacture missing events
phase_1.selection_constraint: Do not choose weights/checkpoints/thresholds using graph_12 labels
phase_1.alert_threshold: Common-input adaptation: threshold=max selected-checkpoint validation event loss; node score=max incident event loss, both endpoints; alert iff node_score > threshold; use_kmeans=false
phase_1.author_original_alert_policy: Frozen run has use_kmeans=true, kmeans_top_K=20: two-cluster KMeans on top-20 test node scores selects the higher-score cluster. This bypasses threshold-based decisions; preserve separately as original offline policy, not validation-only thresholding.
phase_1.empty_alert_policy: Record NO_ALERTS and skip conditioned retrieval; do not retune using development attack labels
phase_1.q_policy: Export only node identity, score, alert flag; freeze identities and their alert windows; no forced Q size of 16
phase_1.note: These split and parameter choices are a proposed starting protocol, not empirically optimal settings. Verify graph availability before execution.

phase_2.reference_requirement: Each RELATED/UNRELATED judgment needs evidence independent of model score and grouping rule; do not force filling strata
phase_2.privacy: No raw logs or credentials in public artifacts
phase_2.sampling: Document fixed strata and sample selection before reading model comparisons; hide method IDs/scores during adjudication
phase_2.claim_limit: 24 fragments are diagnostic material, not 24 independent attacks and not a population-accuracy estimate

phase_3.operation_vocabulary: Identical between A/B initially; FORK/ACCEPT inclusion is a separate factor
phase_3.q: Same frozen phase_1 Q across all arms
phase_3.candidate_policy: Generate original neighbor relations once per input version; use induced restriction after truncation; identical candidates across methods within each version
phase_3.candidate_start: Events incident to frozen Q in their recorded alert windows; preserve equal per-anchor initial mass
phase_3.candidate_reporting: Report truncation and known-node coverage ceiling before interpreting ranking results; these bounds do not establish long-duration APT recovery
phase_3.time_ties: Adjacent timestamp groups; abstain when either group has multiple events, and report abstention rate
phase_3.budget_scope: Node budget includes Q; if Q exceeds a budget, record INFEASIBLE instead of silently changing Q or the budget
phase_3.cost_reporting: Report actual input records read and actual output events/nodes, not just budget ceilings
phase_3.primary_endpoint: New hits on fixed node reference at the primary budget; explicitly only a retrieval metric
phase_3.secondary_endpoint: Relevant/irrelevant/unknown event counts on the independently adjudicated subset; disclose selection and uncertainty
phase_3.forbidden_inference: Node-hit gains do not establish activity membership or causal path recovery

phase_4.holdout_rule: Group by distinct attack instance/host/scenario and document prior exposure; nearby windows and random seeds are not independent attacks
stop_rules: No independently supported activity-mixing examples: remove disentanglement motivation
Input repair explains gains: retain engineering result, withdraw mechanism attribution
Simple method matches result at comparable actual cost: remove unnecessary module
Only development-case gain: do not claim generalization
No independent event reference: keep event membership/causal metrics unavailable
